# 9043 -- the Inferno. Kronos has no row for it because the Inferno is
# instanced there too, and its music player keys off the live map square, which
# an instance never occupies. The square is the Inferno's TEMPLATE, which is
# what torirs_server_world.c now resolves an instanced player's music through (see
# docs/INFERNO_SOUNDS.md section 6):
#   ^inferno_template = 0_35_83_0_0   (inferno.constant), world base 2240,5312
# The track is DBTable 44 row 2811 in this cache -- display name "Inferno",
# js5 index-6 archive 500, unlock varp 17 bit 13 -- and its own unlock hint
# reads "in the Inferno.", which is the game stating this mapping itself.
# `docs/audio/music_track_names.tsv` independently recovers archive 500's name
# from its reference-table hash as `inferno`.
# Rows below this line (region 9043 excepted, added earlier) are from the OSRS
# Wiki's Bucket API -- Module:Music map's underlying data store, which backs the
# wiki's interactive music-track map layer with exact GeoJSON polygons in real
# world-tile coordinates (not rendered-map pixel positions). Sourced 2026-08-13
# via `bucket('music').select('map.features','page_name',...).join('map', ...)`
# against oldschool.runescape.wiki/api.php?action=bucket. Each track's polygon
# was point-sampled (100 pts) per candidate 64x64 map square; a square counts as
# claimed when every sample point falls inside the polygon. Matched against
# music_tracks_osrs239.tsv with the same case-insensitive display/sort-name join
# tools/gen_music_regions.py already uses. Two existing rows above (region 9520
# `Castlewars`, region 13362 `Duel Arena`) had their track_name corrected in
# place to `Castle Wars` / `Emir's Arena, The` -- the real track names in
# music_tracks_osrs239.tsv; those two squares were previously unmatched dead rows.
# Excluded from this import: `Watch Your Step`'s polygon (33 squares, region ids
# 8794-10334) was drawn at a coarse zoom level and spans a landmass-scale area for
# what is actually one building (the Hallowed Sepulchre) -- almost certainly
# overshoots the real footprint, so it is left unmapped rather than imported wrong.
# Also excluded (not attempted): OSRS's ambient-rotation areas, where one square
# plays a random pick from several tracks rather than one fixed track -- the
# Wilderness (27 tracks), the Kharidian Desert (8 tracks), and sailing routes (10
# tracks, and the wiki's own page disclaims their boundaries as unreliable) -- and
# ~100 two-track pairs (mostly Theatre of Blood / Chambers of Xeric boss-phase
# alternates, e.g. Verzik's phases) where picking one arbitrary winner seemed worse
# than omitting. None of these fit this repo's one-track-per-square model.
